newsitem.title: FINLAND: Telenordia has network deal with UPM.
newsitem.headline: Telenordia has network deal with UPM.

text.p: Telenordia Oy, the Finnish arm of Nordic telecoms group Telenordia, said on Friday it had sealed a deal to supply an international telecommunications network to Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy .
"Telenordia has agreed with UPM-Kymmene on the delivery of an international telecommunications trunk network," Telenordia said in a statement. It gave no value of the deal.
Construction of the Europe-wide network would begin immediately it said.
The network will link UPM-Kymmene's regional telecommunications nodes in Britain, Germany, France and Finland, it said.
Telenordia is owned by British Telecom, Norwegian state-owned telecoms group Telenor and Tele Denmark, and supplies telecommunications services in the Nordic region, it said.
